role: End-user manual describing every tab, screen, setting, metric, the Flo assistant, workouts, Get Me Back, Watch companion, privacy and troubleshooting, with concrete thresholds and defaults.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual
units.does: no behavioural claim: manual title.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Overview
units.does: Claims three functions: overnight recovery from Polar H10/Verity Sense RR, workouts (10 sports listed) with GPS/Watch/strap HR and Stryd/FTMS/PM5 power, and Flo answering on-device or with the user's API key; integrates HealthKit; not a medical device.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > App Navigation
units.does: Claims a 5-tab layout (Dashboard, Record, Fitness, Flo, More) with Trends/Settings/Help/About under More, History via Dashboard View all; Fitness tab hideable, Flo can be turned off on next launch, collapsing to 3 tabs; Watch app embedded and WatchConnectivity on by default.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > App Navigation > Naming
units.does: Claims Flo = chat, Coach = mid-workout voice ('Coach here'), Flo Report = email. Matches AssistantSubsystem.voiceAnnouncement (AIProvider.swift:144-151).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the Dashboard tab.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Recovery Score Card
units.does: Claims: 0-100 score using ln(RMSSD) z-scores against the last 60 recorded nights; HRV 60 / Sleep 25 / Vitals 15 with Tier 1/2/3; SpO2 below 95% applies -10; score timing nights 3/7/14; pips 0-13 / 14-27 / 28+; readiness modulation (at most 55% excess kept, 30% of gap given back); Comeback mode HRV 80 / Sleep 20 / Vitals 0 for 21 days; verdict bands 90/75/60/45/30. Verified: BaselineTracker uses the last 60 stored nights (BaselineTracker.swift:210-213) with minimumDays 3; ScoreVerdict.init bands (ScoreVerdict.swift:30-38); ConfidencePip 14/28 thresholds; RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:7-15 weights and comeback; ReadinessScoring trust 0.55 (ReadinessScoring.swift:89).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Today's Loop
units.does: Claims a one-sentence 'Today's Loop' line under the score that becomes tappable when readiness changed.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Feeling Chip
units.does: Claims a feeling chip showing the morning feeling or 'Tap how you feel', editable, saved on the night's session.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > HRV / Sleep / Vitals / Load Chips
units.does: Claims four chips HRV/Sleep/Vitals/Load each opening a detail view; the HRV and Sleep chips say when an older night was recorded (nightAgeLabel: relative day name under a week, else the date; nothing for last night); Load hidden when Fitness tab hidden or training load paused.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Recent Strip
units.does: Claims a 7-day Recent strip; View all opens History; verdict words appear after 30 nights of baseline.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Multi-Segment Recovery
units.does: Claims paused/resumed or same-night sessions within the merge window are combined for window selection and scoring.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Estimated Sleep When Apple Health Has None
units.does: Claims that with no Apple Health sleep the app estimates sleep from the overnight HR drop (strap RR first, then Watch HR), automatically when morning results open, only for nights with no sleep.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Morning Feeling Badge
units.does: Claims a 1-5 pre-score feeling prompt shown before the score, optional tags for ratings 1-2, editable later, and divergence detection when self-rating differs from HRV by more than one category.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Dashboard Toolbar (top-right)
units.does: Claims three toolbar icons: Notifications (its Daily morning report Format picker: Teaser never shows the score, Full readout always does, Auto sends a teaser until 30 nights of readings and then the score only while Show Previews is not Always, per MorningNotificationScheduler.resolvedFormat), Send Report menu (recovery/daily/workout PDF rendered off the main actor into the mail composer, Browse all reports) and Ask Flo shortcuts that auto-send and switch to Flo.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Before Your First Reading
units.does: Claims a Get started checklist (Pair device, Connect Apple Health, Take your first reading) replaces chips and strip with no readings; its Take your first reading row (firstReadingRow -> onStartRecording) opens the Record tab.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for detail views.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > HRV Detail View
units.does: Claims HRV detail hero label from ln(RMSSD) vs baseline, falling back to absolute RMSSD 60/45/30 ms bands; HR strip, autonomic capacity, trends vs 30-day average, waveform, Poincaré, beat consistency, advanced tabs; artifact banner above 10% corrected beats.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Sleep Detail View
units.does: Claims a sleep score with weights Duration 25 / Efficiency 20 / Stages 20 (deep 10, REM 10) / Fragmentation 15 / Cycles 10 / Architecture 10, short-night cap 90 → 60, stage source Watch or estimated from chest strap RR, vitals grid, quality and insight cards.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Sleep Detail View > Adjust Sleep Screen
units.does: Describes SleepTimelineEditorView opened from Adjust (adjustSleepButton) or Edit sleep (editSleepButton): one timeline of segments, tap to select, drag handles (no crossing a neighbour, 1-minute snap), Split with preview / Carve Awake / Merge / Delete, long-press to add stage-less sleep, live stage pills, TOTAL SLEEP with a signed delta, Undo (5 steps), Reset, Refresh from Apple Health (asks first over edits made); Done saves and rescores, Cancel discards (asks first when there is anything to lose, and the sheet cannot be swiped away then); opening the app does not rewrite history.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Training Detail View
units.does: Claims ACR card and labels <0.8 Below usual, 0.8-1.0 Maintenance, 1.0-1.3 In range, 1.3-1.5 Above usual, >1.5 Sharp increase; Foster monotony/strain banner; recent workouts with TRIMP.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Vitals Detail View
units.does: Claims vitals detail with status banner, score card, expandable RHR / respiratory rate (7-day baseline) / SpO2 / wrist temperature cards, an explanation card, and a refresh when Apple Health delivers new vitals (VitalsDetailV2View.body re-runs refreshVitals on vitalsDataVersion).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > First Launch (Onboarding)
units.does: Claims a mandatory device-local Health Disclaimer gate, then a 7-page onboarding (Welcome, What Emuqu does, Profile, Sensor with a Skip button, Apple Health, Backup, You're In) with pages 1-6 skippable and onboarding reappearing if killed before page 7.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > First Launch (Onboarding) > What onboarding does NOT capture (set these later in Settings)
units.does: Claims fallbacks: max HR 208 − 0.7 × age (Tanaka), or 180 without a birthday (MaxHeartRate.effective); LTHR 0.88 × max HR never below 120 (UserSettings.effectiveLTHR); body weight 75 kg; units follow region; the α1 aerobic-threshold estimate is not LTHR.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the Record tab.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Session Type Selection
units.does: Claims session-first flow with Extended (default) and Quick Reading (2/3/5 min).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Connection Section
units.does: Claims known-device list with swipe/long-press removal, scanning list with dBm, connected device panel (battery, Verity ~30 h estimate, firmware, H10 memory), and battery gating: <10% disables recording, 10-20% advisory. Verified RecordView+Actions.swift:14 (battery < 10) and :19 (10..<20).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Tag Selection
units.does: Claims a horizontal row of system tags followed by any selected custom tag (ReadingTagSelector.tagChipRow) with More opening the full tag picker.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Extended Recording (Overnight / Multi-Hour)
units.does: Claims extended recording flow: Morning tag auto-added when ending 4-10 AM; pause runs a full analysis and saves; Continue Recovery card within merge window; auto-finalize at strap battery <= 5% while paused; best 5-minute window; report opens automatically; H10 upload refines score; Verity disconnects. Verified Morning-tag hour gate 4..<10 (RecordView+Results.swift:176). Discarding a Recording: Discard Recording under the controls with a confirmation offering Discard (nothing kept: no score, session, crash-recovery or iCloud backup; the strap's own copy cleared when it was recording one), Discard and Start Over, Keep Recording; a discarded resumed segment returns to its paused night; Discard Night on a paused night removes it and the segments it was built from; a strap copy that cannot be cleared is reported and goes to Lost Sessions at the next start. Verified against RecordPanels.discardButton/discardConfirmActions and CollectorSessionControl.discardOvernightRecording/discardPausedRecording.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Quick Reading Section (Spot Check)
units.does: Claims quick reading 2/3/5 min with countdown, progress ring, breathing mandala, voice guide, Stop Early (a reading with at least 120 beats, CollectorSessionControl.minimumQuickReadingBeats, is still saved), and a Reading Complete card.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Data Quality Verification
units.does: Claims verification shows quality badge, window duration, quality %, artifact % (<10% good), clean beats (200+ good). Verified artifactPercent < 10 check (RecordVerificationSection.swift:54).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Results Preview
units.does: Claims extended results open the full report with Done/Discard, Discard asking first (see Notes Section), and an upward arrow when H10 data improved the score; quick readings show Reading Complete.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Data Recovery
units.does: Claims device-memory recovery alerts (Recover Data; 'Delete from [Device Name]', which confirms first and deletes the only copy, stopping a running recording; Retry Fetch) and, after a crash mid-recording, a launch 'Session Interrupted' alert with Resume, Save as Complete (Save to Archive when not resumable) and Dismiss, where Dismiss only stops the alert for that session and the backup stays recoverable from Settings → iCloud & Data → Recover Lost Sessions; for a workout launch auto-recovery may be holding, Resume and Save wait up to 150 s in all (EmuquApp.claimRecovery) and then say 'Saved to your archive.' or that it is still being recovered and where to recover it otherwise.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant)
units.does: Claims Flo chats with one of six providers; every message carries the current time and training-load headline; Apple Intelligence also gets the rendered recovery context (today, yesterday, 14 days, baselines, 7/30-day trends, morning feeling) via compactRender; a cloud model gets only the today/yesterday live-state block (AssistantContext.renderLiveStateForCloud, plus location during a live workout) and fetches the rest with tools.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Adaptive Routing — Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual
units.does: Claims routing acts only with Apple Intelligence selected and that with Apple there is no text field (suggestion chips or voice only; ChatInputBar.appleOnlyComposerHint), voice skipping tiers, so the modes route chip questions; Quick answers on Apple; Auto classifies four capability axes (keyword AND embedding >= 0.55) and sends flagged turns to consented Grok then DeepSeek; 3 settling turns then sticky-up unless zero flags; after 50 cloud Deep turns a day further Deep turns are marked Auto, which with Apple selected maps to the same Grok/DeepSeek model so the cap does not reduce cloud use; Deep uses the same consented model; voice and action requests go to the first consented cloud; earcon; 14-pattern deterministic catalog; tier dot; AFM prewarm 'during init'; cache-health card.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > First Use
units.does: Claims a one-time disclaimer covering on-device Apple, connected-model data sharing, reply filtering (diagnostic/offensive sentence removal, number correction) and Report response by email; accepted once.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Choosing a Provider
units.does: Claims a model picker listing Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+), Claude Haiku 4.5/Sonnet 4.6/Opus 4.7, ChatGPT GPT-6 Luna/GPT-5.4 mini/GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite/3.8 Flash/3.1 Pro Preview, Grok 4.3/4.7, DeepSeek Flash/V4 Pro; a Set up Flo screen when the selected model cannot take a turn (no Apple Intelligence or key, or switched off; ProviderRegistry.canSend via activeProviderAvailable) and none can take over (keysChanged); keys in device-only Keychain. Display names come from each provider's static models (KeyedCloudProvider.availableModels); APIKeyStore stores keys ThisDeviceOnly.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > The Chat Screen
units.does: Claims chat screen: model chip, Stop, ⋯ menu, voice toggle top-left, 10 pre-fab chips, input row only for paid models (Apple path shows a caption instead), typing indicator, markdown streaming, auto-scroll. Verified 10 PrefabQuestion cases and the Apple-only composer hint (AssistantChatSupport.swift:125-145).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > How the assistant fetches your data (tool use)
units.does: Claims every provider uses tool use, prompt is small and cache-stable, hard cap 8 tool calls per question, Apple transcript trimmed verbatim at 70% of 4K keeping the latest user turn, the Apple session reused only while the chat's last exchange is the one it answered (SessionCache.canReuse) and rotated after 20 turns.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > What the AI can do beyond reading your data
units.does: Claims [ACTION] tools for saved routes, navigation (walking route, <10 ms follow-ups, 'never mind' clears), location, email draft + contacts, memory, web search; when the value to save (memory fact, contact, address, route name) is not in the user's latest message the tool asks first and changes nothing until yes (DestructiveActionContext.gateUnlessUserStated); an email draft or new contact needs the user's latest message to ask for it (user_quote); read-back of results and verbatim disambiguation.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Where am I / what's nearby
units.does: Claims location answers from a warm resolved-address cache (workout pipeline or ambient service when foregrounded) including nearest cross street; verbal forward-geocoding fallback.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Where am I / what's nearby > `location_situation` — one-call situational awareness
units.does: Claims location_situation bundles address, heading/speed, POIs in five categories (empty vs failed distinguished), next turn, journey block from JourneyIntelligenceService and recurrence from RecurrenceClassifier (buckets of the start rounded to 100 m and the start time's four-hour band, bucketKey; 75 m mean offset; >= 2 prior trails).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Where am I / what's nearby > `location_roads_ahead` — forward-looking road awareness
units.does: Claims location_roads_ahead returns the next 1-3 intersections; a confidence below 0.4 or nil phrase forces 'I don't have road data'. Verified confidence >= 0.4 && phrase != nil gate (AppFactResolver+LiveNavigation.swift:92).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Training-load projections — composable AI primitives
units.does: Claims projection primitives training.load.snapshot, training.project_from, training.days_until_converged_from (notRecorded beyond 60 days), training.projected_tsb. Verified patterns exist and the 60-day unmet message (AppFactResolver+TrainingProjections.swift:296).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Pre-fab Questions
units.does: Lists the 10 pre-fab chips and what each asks. Matches PrefabQuestion cases (PrefabQuestions.swift:29-58).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Voice Input — two modes
units.does: Claims dictation uses on-device recognition (requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true) and puts the final transcript after the text already typed once the recognizer's final words arrive (ChatInputBar.toggleDictation, SpeechInputManager.stop); Settings → Flo → Speech recognizer chooses Apple Speech or WhisperKit (English only, ~100 MB download) for voice mode; voice replies limited to 1-3 sentences.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Voice Input — two modes > Interrupting the AI
units.does: Claims interrupt needs at least two words, sustained noise alone never triggers, mic button and Stop both kill LLM and TTS, Send now force-commits.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Voice Input — two modes > Known voice limitations
units.does: Claims AirPods recommended, whispers below ~-40 dBFS do not register, system interruptions tear voice down without auto-resume.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Long-Press Any Message
units.does: Claims the long-press menu: Remember this (saved as the user's own fact, AssistantViewModel.remember), Copy, Share, Send email, Regenerate (last non-local assistant turn, not while streaming; asks for a pending consent first; refused with Flo off, regenerateLast), Report response (assistant turns); Remember and Copy use the displayed text without pronunciation marks.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Web Search (optional, opt-in)
units.does: Claims opt-in Tavily web search (key in Keychain, toggle), curated research/manufacturer whitelists and excluded sites, with Anthropic running its own search on Claude; prompt rules on citing and one search per turn. Domain lists match WebSearchService.swift:39-97.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Cross-Session Memory ("What the AI Remembers")
units.does: Claims persistent memory facts injected into every conversation, added manually, via Remember this, or via Auto-remember (off by default; a background extraction pass after each response that completes, only while mayExtractFacts allows: Flo on, a provider that can take a turn, consent); the user's own facts and inferred ones are sent under separate headers (systemPromptBlock); at most 25, oldest pruned, duplicates skipped (UserFactsStore.add); stored on device only.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Tappable Date Citations
units.does: Claims dates matching an archived session render as tappable links opening a read-only quick view.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Switching Models Mid-Conversation
units.does: Claims history carries across provider switches, truncated to each model's budget with an auto-summary.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Long Conversations
units.does: Claims older turns are dropped from the send window and replaced with an auto-summary; Clear conversation deletes the history, the summary and chat exports, a summary update under way writes nothing, and a failed erase says 'The conversation couldn't be fully erased. Try again.' (AssistantViewModel.clearConversation).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Keyboard Dismissal
units.does: no behavioural claim: keyboard dismissal gestures.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Cost Notes (Connected Models)
units.does: Claims no in-app cost display; Anthropic prompt caching makes sends within ~5 minutes reuse the cached system prompt at ~10% cost; others cache server-side.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Known Limitations
units.does: Claims known limitations: Apple safety refusals, cold start, 4K window, no monthly/yearly aggregation tools, fabrication risk, unpinned non-Claude model IDs, single thread, citation picks latest session of a day, voice MVP.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History
units.does: Claims History opens from Dashboard View all and lists sessions from in-memory metadata.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Session Type Filter
units.does: Claims type filter chips All / Extended / Naps / Quick / Breathe. Verified five chips (HistoryView.swift:473-492).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Tag Filter
units.does: Claims a tag filter row with OR semantics across selected tags.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Search
units.does: Claims search by date (the app-locale medium date), tag name (system tags in the app language) or notes (HistoryViewModel.applyFilters).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Session List
units.does: Claims pagination 10 at a time grouped Today/Yesterday/This Week/Last Week/Month Year, with row contents incl. recovery score on the dashboard verdict ladder.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Swipe Actions
units.does: Claims swipe-left Delete without full-swipe (asks first) and swipe-right Edit Tags, offered only on non-workout readings with an RMSSD (opensTagEditor), opening the reading at its tag editor.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Long-Press a Row
units.does: Claims long-press 'Ask Flo about this session' pre-fills a question for sessions in the last ~30 days.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Tap Session
units.does: Claims tapping a session opens MorningResultsView in a sheet, and a reading that cannot be read shows 'Couldn't open this reading. Try again.' (loadAndSelect/reportLoadFailure).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Empty State
units.does: Claims empty state with Clear Filters when filtering.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Trends
units.does: Claims Trends (More → Trends) over overnight readings only: tag chips, 7/14/30/90/All ranges, overall trend, metric chart with ±1 SD band once 4 overnight readings in the last 60 days, stats grid, insights needing >= 3 readings, training-load calendar whose day sheet lists that day's readings with headline numbers, deletes by long-press and opens nothing (open from History); an overnight sits on its wake morning.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView)
units.does: no behavioural claim: heading for MorningResultsView.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Header Section
units.does: Claims header with quality badge Excellent if artifact <5% else Good, beat count, window info.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Key Metrics Section
units.does: Claims the report's half-width HRV card (beside the Sleep card) shows RMSSD with Excellent/Good/Fair/Reduced/Low from AppTheme.hrvCategory against the scoring baseline, falling back to age- and sex-adjusted bands without one, and navigates to SessionHRVDetailView, which uses the same baseline label plus HR stats; the Sleep card opens Sleep detail.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Readiness Section
units.does: Claims a Recovery Readiness gauge on a 0-10 scale.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Training Load Section
units.does: Claims a training-load section only when data exists (ACR gauge, ATL/CTL/TRIMP, recent workouts), opening the Training detail, which follows the live load for today's reading and keeps a past night's frozen load (trainingDetailLink followsLiveLoad).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Analysis Summary Section
units.does: Claims a generated analysis summary paragraph.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Analysis Window
units.does: Claims window method picker (Best Recovery default, Highest RMSSD/SDNN, Highest Total Power using SDNN so it picks the Highest SDNN window): a pick asks for confirmation (it replaces the saved score), then re-runs this night's analysis; a declined re-analysis alerts and keeps the score; a pick on today's report is stored as settings.defaultWindowSelectionMethod, seeds every later report's picker (MorningResultsViewModel.init) and the Dashboard re-analyze (refreshDashboard), while a past night's pick re-scores that night only and new recordings always use Best Recovery; manual Choose Window mode with Auto/Yours/Diff compare banner; Apply replaces the night's analysis while keeping the auto pick.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Peak Capacity Section
units.does: Claims a Peak Capacity card with the highest sustained 5-minute HRV period.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Session Charts Section
units.does: Claims context-dependent chart titles, HRV chart first with pinned cursor and Analyze Here, HR chart with sleep stage overlay.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Tags Section
units.does: Claims tags editable on the report.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Notes Section
units.does: Claims notes and tag changes are saved on Done or when the report closes, swipe included (saveTagsAndNotesIfChanged from the Done button and .onDisappear, only when they differ from what was last stored), and that Discard asks for confirmation naming what is lost (night, RecordView.readingDiscardMessage: out of the baseline, to the Trash if already saved, a night in the history before this recording left as it was; quick reading: to the Trash; import: dropped unsaved) and then throws the reading away with its tag and note changes.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Action Buttons
units.does: Claims Email Report builds a PDF with selectable sections (Metrics & Data, Visualizations for raw-RR sessions, Analysis Summary); Delete from History confirms then moves the reading to the Trash, restorable from Settings → iCloud & Data → Trash for 90 days (ArchiveStore.moveToTrash, expiredDeletionIds keepDays 90); Reanalyze asks first because the new score replaces the saved one (beat data unchanged, reanalyzeMessage), and a re-analysis that cannot run raises an alert and leaves the score as it was.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: Fitness tab overview.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Fitness tab dashboard
units.does: Claims a hero card for the latest workout (sport badge, distance, polyline, badge row), 7/30-day tiles, passive activity card, Get Me Back card, recent list whose long-press Delete Workout asks first and moves the workout to the Trash, with an alert on the tab when the move fails (deleteRecentWorkout).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Get Me Back mode
units.does: Claims Get Me Back captures fixes every 30 s or 25 m, hides the arrow above 100 m accuracy, saves atomically per fix; SOS dials 911 (NA + PH), 999/000/111/119/120/193 elsewhere, else 112; Clear offers keep/end-save/discard; workout trails auto-archived, up to 50 kept. Verified timeCommitSeconds 30 and movementCommitMeters 25 (BreadcrumbRecorder.swift:69-73), accuracy cap 100 m (:226), archiveRetentionLimit 50 (BreadcrumbStore.swift:155), emergencyNumber switch (GetMeBackView.swift:743-752).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Starting a workout
units.does: Claims Start auto-reconnects the paired strap and Stryd, strap stays ~120 s for HRR then disconnects; sport list; HR source automatic (strap when connected or paired, else Watch; WorkoutPlanModel.resolvedSource); target zone with no spoken drift nudge (zone.drifted rules are .silent); interval plans; ambient-coach thresholds in plain words (HR bpm, %FTP, elevation gain, grade, elapsed time, distance per WorkoutThreshold.parsePlainText) with debounce/cooldown, distance and climb cues spoken in miles/feet for an imperial units preference (WorkoutThreshold.progressCue); route binding via trail discovery (2-50 km radius), GPX, or saved-route recognition after ~500 m.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Live road context
units.does: Claims the road name comes from Apple Maps data first, then Apple's geocoder (performLookup), after ~15 m or 60 s, backing off to every 30 s after 8 consecutive failures; the coach gets it in its live context. Constants movementThresholdMeters 15 and timeThresholdSec 60.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Power meters
units.does: Claims Stryd over Cycling Power + RSC at 1 Hz, FTMS trainers, PM5; running/cycling FTP set separately; every power workout records average/peak power, NP and VI (applyPowerAggregates), IF and power load only with an FTP (applyFTPAnchoredMetrics), no set-FTP prompt; post-summary LOAD tile shows power load when present with an HRSS tile beside it; NP shown in the History calendar row; IF and VI shown nowhere, read by Flo.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > My Routes (route library + route-aware coaching)
units.does: Claims post-summary 'Add to my route library', management in Settings → My Routes (rename; delete asks first and the coach stops recognising the route), direction-agnostic recognition after ~500 m giving the coach climbs, ascent remaining, peak, steepest grade.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Live weather context
units.does: Claims MET Norway weather with location rounded to ~1 km, refreshed ~30 min (never more than every 10 min), saved at workout end for heat tracking. Verified WeatherService.cacheTTL 30*60 (WeatherService.swift:45).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Zwift / TrainerRoad / Rouvy broadcaster
units.does: Claims enableZwiftBroadcast (Settings → Wearables, first-enable explainer that each device has to accept; a setting restored from iCloud on a new device stays off there until accepted) advertises HR + Cycling Power services; off by default.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > During a workout (live view)
units.does: Claims live tiles update each second; α1 tile explains unavailability; power/METs tiles when live; live map.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Voice coach
units.does: Claims the voice coach evaluates a rule engine each tick: user-added thresholds (user.threshold.breach, urgent .spoken) are spoken and buzz the phone and Watch; a dropped strap (equipment.strapDown, urgent .haptic) is spoken and buzzes, naming the Watch only while the wrist heart rate is live (WorkoutAIContext.wristHeartRateLive), else 'check its fit and battery'; an HR spike without pace (hr.spikeNoPace) and a cadence drop (cadence.consistencyDrop) only buzz (routine .haptic); α1, HR drift, zone drift and climb-ahead rules are .silent and kept in history; coach alerts off or the coach muted silences all of these (WorkoutVoiceCoach.tick's canAlert); a full live snapshot is available to the AI.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Post-workout summary
units.does: Claims the summary opens instantly with HRR captured over 120 s; lists cards (map, stats, HRR, charts, α1 timeline with AT1 0.75 / AT2 0.50, route by α1, α1 LT1 ±10 bpm, crossings, zone distribution on configured max HR, derived metrics, decoupling/EF, splits, GPX/CSV/TCX export with recorded fix times when stored, else evenly spread and noted); the Generate & Email Coach Report button (CoachReportButton) is disabled only while preparing, then says the email is ready or that the PDF failed and it can be tapped again; deleting from the summary asks first and moves the workout to the Trash.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Training load — how TRIMP and HRSS are computed
units.does: Claims TRIMP = Banister with A=0.64,k=1.92 (male) / A=0.86,k=1.67 (female) on heart-rate reserve; HRSS = TRIMP / TRIMP(1 h at LTHR) × 100; LTHR default 0.88 × max HR; resting HR order user → baseline → 60 bpm. Verified WorkoutAnalyzer.banisterTRIMP/beatTRIMP (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:240-280) via TrainingConstants.TRIMP; Edwards fallback when max/rest HR missing.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Power-based training load (when you have a power meter)
units.does: Claims NP (Coggan: 30-sample rolling averages within unbroken power runs, 4th power, 4th root; nil with no 30-sample run; computeNormalizedPower), IF, power-TSS, VI computed when a power source and matching FTP exist; the card points to where to set FTP; an HRSS tile beside a power-based load (appendSecondaryLoadTile).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Running FTP auto-estimator
units.does: Claims the running FTP estimator scans 90 days, requires 90% power coverage in a 20-minute window, FTP = best 20-min × 0.95, cached in UserDefaults, recomputed weekly off the main thread and sooner when a workout was added or the anchor deleted (needsRecompute), cleared when nothing qualifies; a workout unreadable for now (ArchiveAccessFailure.mayClear) leaves the scan unstamped and never lowers the estimate, one unreadable for good does not hold it open. Constants lookbackDays 90, minimumPowerCoverage 0.9, twentyMinuteToFTPFactor 0.95.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > One-shot load backfill
units.does: Claims WorkoutLoadBackfill runs weekly over 90 days applying RouteTRIMPEstimator to route-matching workouts, idempotent, run in the background at launch after the sync and skipped in Low Power Mode (EmuquApp.workoutLoadBackfillWork in scheduleSyncThenTrainingJobs), left unstamped when a workout cannot be read or written for now (ArchiveAccessFailure.mayClear) but not for a permanently unreadable one, re-running when saved-route count changes, with prior/outlier rules and replacement only when recorded TRIMP < half the estimate.
calls: Emuqu/Sources/Analysis/RouteTRIMPEstimator.swift::func RouteTRIMPEstimator.isCleanPrior(_: HRVSession, sport: Sport, before: Date)

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Turn-by-turn alerts (opt-in)
units.does: Claims two Notifications → Navigation toggles (turn-by-turn voice alerts at ~500 ft/~200 ft/at turn via TurnAlertEngine; turn-as-marker split recaps), both default off.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Validated physiology references
units.does: Lists cited references (Banister 1991, Rogers & Gronwald 2021, HRSS derivation, Friel LTHR, Strava DEM threshold — Emuqu uses 15 m).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Elevation accuracy — how Emuqu actually measures it
units.does: Claims headline elevation from barometer only: a 15-second symmetric moving average timed by the samples' timestamps and 2 m hysteresis at stop; older recordings can query USGS NED 10 m / SRTM 30 m DEM with a 15 m sustained-climb threshold; per-split elevation from GPS altitude with the same smoother. BarometricAltitudeProcessor.process (smootherWindow 15, movingAverage windowSeconds) and 2.0 m threshold, TopoElevationService.sustainedClimb.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Repairing α1 on historical walks
units.does: Claims a 'Re-analyze α1 for this session' button replays artifact filter + DFA on stored RR and writes corrected α1.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Data quality filters
units.does: Claims cadence caps 125 spm walk/hike, 220 run/treadmill, 140 RPM bike, 60 row/CrossFit, and a cadence-chart tail-spike filter (last min(15, n/4) samples vs the median of up to 30 before them, cut at the first >= 1.5x; under 20 points left alone).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Home-screen Widget + Live Activity
units.does: Claims there is no home-screen widget or Live Activity.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Apple Watch Companion App
units.does: Claims the Watch app mirrors the live workout, keeps an HKWorkoutSession alive without saving an HKWorkout, ends on its own after 30 minutes of phone silence or End while unreachable and then shows 'Ended on Watch. Open Emuqu on your iPhone to finish the workout.' (LiveMetricsScreen.endedOnWatchView), and forwards wrist HR as fallback. Verified phoneSilenceLimit 30*60 (WatchMessageDecoding.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Apple Watch Companion App > Watch strap pairing
units.does: Claims WatchStrapConnector pairs a Polar or any HR Service (180D/2A37) device, persists the last peripheral in UserDefaults, pushes watchStrapSample to iOS, and the Watch does not request bluetooth-central background mode. Verified WKBackgroundModes lists only workout-processing (EmuquWatch Watch App/Info.plist:35-38).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Apple Watch Companion App > Known Watch limitations
units.does: Claims Watch is not standalone, a wrist Start is refused while the iPhone already records a workout ('A workout is already recording on your iPhone.', EmuquApp.watchStartRefusal / refusalText), requests HealthKit on first Start, and surfaces HKWorkoutSession start failures via lastStartError.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Help Center
units.does: Claims Help Center (More → Help & Learn) has 12 searchable categories listed.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: Settings hub heading.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Profile
units.does: Claims profile fields: birthday (a 'Birthday — Not Set' row with none, birthdayPicker), age, fitness level (7 options), biological sex, temperature unit.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Sleep
units.does: Claims typical sleep 5-10 h in 0.5 h steps plus a stored value outside them (typicalSleepPicker), bedtime default 10 PM defining overnight windows, wake time derived, Combine Segments Off / Default 4.5 h / Custom 1-12 h. customMergeGapHours default 4.5 clamped 1...12.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Profile, Biometrics, Sleep, Training, Wearables
units.does: Claims Biometrics ranges (Max HR 80-230, Resting 30-110, LTHR 80-220, weight 25-250 kg, VO2max 10-100), Home Address stored and synced with settings; Sleep toggles incl. HRV-Enhanced Watch Stages (overrides deep/core and REM/awake where HRV strongly disagrees; an estimate) and 'Lower Score Without Sleep' −10; Training break; Wearables export toggles and HR-detected sleep export as asleep/awake/in-bed; workout active energy written net of resting metabolism (HealthKitWorkoutExport.netMETs via activeEnergySamples); a re-export (after a trim, or from another device) replaces Emuqu's own earlier copy and never another source's samples (sync identifiers, EarlierExport, HealthSampleReplacer); a workout saved while the phone was locked has its earlier copy removed on the next return to the app (PendingWorkoutReplacements.finish).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Appearance
units.does: Claims Background theme Light/Dim/Dark and six colour themes (Blue default, Teal, Indigo, Purple, Rose, Orange).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Language
units.does: Claims 17 languages switchable without restart. Verified Localizable.xcstrings carries exactly 17 locales (ar, da, de, en, es, fi, fr, is, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pt-BR, ru, sv, zh-Hans).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Custom Tags
units.does: Claims custom tag list with swipe delete and a creation sheet with a 12-colour grid; a new name is trimmed and one already in use (case-insensitive) is refused (AddTagSheet.canSave).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Flo (AI Assistant)
units.does: Claims Flo settings page: no on/off switch (Performance & Battery instead, next launch), connected-model key editors, On-Device row, AI routing picker disabled unless Apple selected with caption and footer text, no-cloud notice, memory section with Auto-remember off by default, disclosure. Verified routingModePicker.disabled and noCloudProviderText (AIAssistantSettingsPage+Sections.swift:175-200).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > iCloud & Data
units.does: Claims iCloud Sync off by default (Health readings never uploaded, computed scores encrypted, sample nights never uploaded per CloudUploadExclusion.sampleData in buildSessionRecord); sync tied to the iCloud account it was enabled for: a different account or deleted iCloud data turns it off, uploads nothing, keeps local sessions and shows the reason under the switch until re-enabled (CloudAccountGuard.stopSync, CloudAccountIdentity.StopReason.message, DataSettingsPage.iCloudSyncDetail); sync status; Force iCloud Sync reports uploads or 'Nothing was synced this time' (forceSyncOutcome); Back Up Settings replaces even a newer cloud copy (pushImmediately(replacingNewerCloudCopy: true)) while automatic backup replaces only an older one, Restore asks first; RR import formats (CSV/JSON/TXT/Kubios/EliteHRV) with >= 60 intervals and >= 3/4 in 300-2000 ms, Export Data with three formats, Recover RR from Strap, Recover Lost Sessions, Trash kept 90 days. Verified expireTrash(keepDays: 90) called at launch (AppLaunchTasks.swift) and export buttons (ExportAndArchiveViews.swift). EliteHRV bullet: RMSSD, and SDNN/pNN50 when the export has them, are Elite HRV's values; metrics it lacks are shown marked 'estimate' and kept out of baselines, trends, the assistant and Apple Health; no stress index, score or beat count is made up, and earlier imports lose the ones they were given (HRVSession.init(from:), ArchiveMigrations.migrateLegacyEliteImportIndex) (RRDataImporter+EliteHRV.swift createAnalyzedSession / eliteEstimatedMetrics).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Troubleshooting
units.does: Claims Troubleshooting page with recent errors, diagnostic log export (health values and GPS removed), reanalyze all, clear actions that each ask first, advanced diagnostics toggle revealing archive diagnostics, repair, log viewer and Clear All Logs (asks first; deletes the debug log and every crash log); Archive Diagnostics' Repair Archive rebuilds the index from readable session files, deletes no file and reports when it cannot finish; Archive Diagnostics deletes no data and points to Delete All My Data.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Advanced Data Controls
units.does: Claims Delete All My Data erases device and iCloud data and API keys after typing DELETE MY DATA plus a confirmation; it is unavailable while a recording is in progress (a reading, a night even paused, a strap recording or a workout) or a reading is waiting to be accepted, until the user stops it or accepts or discards the reading; trial record and encryption keys stay in the keychain. iCloud Sync is turned off before the remote delete and stays off; other devices stop syncing with a notice (CloudAccountGuard.zoneWasDeleted); a recording started during the remote delete leaves this device untouched (Refusal.recordingStartedDuringDelete); the zones are deleted only in the account synced with, or with none recorded unless sync was stopped for a different account (mayDeleteInSignedInAccount), and when the remote step fails local data is still removed and the report says the iCloud records were not deleted; Apple Health samples are not removed and the report's footer says where to remove them.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Help & Support
units.does: Claims Help & Support rows: Help Center, Metric Guide, Troubleshooting.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > Purchase
units.does: Claims one-time purchase after a 30-day free trial started from the paywall, reminder only in the last week, trial survives reinstall, beta testers keep free access. Verified EntitlementAnchor durationDays 30 (EntitlementAnchor.swift:460) and PaywallGatePolicy.reminderWindowDays 7.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Settings Tab > About
units.does: Claims About lists version, Terms of Use (with navigation guidance notice), Privacy Policy, Health Disclaimer.

units.does: no behavioural claim: Trash view heading.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Trash View > When Empty
units.does: Claims empty-trash copy.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Trash View > With Deleted Sessions
units.does: Claims trash rows with restore (re-analyzes) and permanent delete, which asks first and removes the session's file, raw backup, iCloud copy, the route a workout filed in the trail history and everything it wrote to Apple Health (HRV, heart rate, resting heart rate, sleep, workout; HealthWriteAndObserve.removeExports); a session that cannot be removed stays and the screen says how many, and when some of what it wrote to Apple Health (heart rate, HRV, sleep or workouts) cannot be deleted it says so with where to remove it in the Health app (TrashView.failureMessage), the message staying until the next action; 90-day footer, Permanently Delete All with confirmation.

units.does: no behavioural claim: Lost Sessions heading.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Lost Sessions View > Features
units.does: Claims lost-session list with date and beat count, Recover All, multi-select delete and swipe delete, each behind a confirmation saying the session is no longer offered for recovery and its backup files stay; a deletion that cannot be saved stays listed with an alert.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > HRV Metrics Explained
units.does: no behavioural claim: heading for metric explanations.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > HRV Metrics Explained > Time Domain Metrics
units.does: Educational table: RMSSD 40-100+ ms, SDNN 50-100+ ms, pNN50 >20% 'good values'; Avg HR is the whole recording's average with rejected beats left out (report header, overnight chart, session details); Min/Max HR are the whole recording's, the lowest and the highest 30-second average (smoothedExtreme over nadirWindowMs); Mean HR in the time-domain metrics is the analysis-window average (about five and a half minutes of calm sleep) that sleep HR, resting HR and the heart-rate baseline use. Verified against HRVAnalysisResult.recordingMeanHR/recordingMinHR/recordingMaxHR and attachOvernightHRStats.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > HRV Metrics Explained > Frequency Domain Metrics
units.does: Educational: LF 0.04-0.15 Hz; HF 0.15-0.4 Hz, most tied to parasympathetic activity at ordinary breathing rates, with slow breathing moving power into LF; LF/HF read as a trend, not a sympathetic index (Billman 2013), raised by slow breathing. Matches MetricInfoSheet.hfPowerEntry / lfhfRatioEntry.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > HRV Metrics Explained > Nonlinear Metrics
units.does: Educational: SD1, SD2, DFA α1 0.75-1.0.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > HRV Metrics Explained > Composite Metrics
units.does: Claims Readiness is a 1-10 nearness score from a neutral 5 (RMSSD near usual, α1 in its resting band, PNS/SNS balance, lifted by recent hard training; StressAnalyzer.computeReadinessScore, MetricInfoSheet.readinessEntry), distinct from the load-based Training Readiness gauge; Recovery 60/25/15 with last-60-nights baseline; Comeback mode 80/20/0 for 21 days via Settings → Modes, auto-expiring.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Privacy & Data
units.does: Claims no server/account; data in app container and App Group; recordings, raw backups, workout routes, settings, saved routes, contacts, trails and Flo's chat and memory sealed with a device-keychain key on top of file protection; keychain items survive app deletion (API keys removable via Delete All My Data); iCloud sync off by default and encrypted, Health readings never uploaded, and tied to the iCloud account it was enabled for (another account turns it off and uploads nothing; CloudAccountGuard.stopSync); cloud AI only with key + consent, receiving chat, tool results, memory facts and a live-state block; Tavily, MET Norway (~1 km), OpenTopoData (<= 100 points, ~11 m), Overpass (100 m / 250 m), Apple, Hugging Face.
